calculation.description: Lagged directional efficiency: the completed 20-trading-day close-to-close return divided by the prior 20-day sum of absolute daily returns. Higher values identify persistent directional movement; the denominator is shifted one session to avoid contemporaneous leakage.

validation.regime_notes: Ten-day IC is positive in 2020-2022 (0.04763), 2023-2024 (0.01403), and 2025-2026 (0.03586). Daily and five-day decay are weak, while the ten-day horizon passes the benchmark gates. The 15-name universe supports broad coverage but requires conservative inference. A preliminary artifact audit found high maximum date-level rank correlation with an existing residual-reversal artifact; deterministic post-Miner audit remains authoritative.
